info.cls_ename: Applied Second Foreign Language Elective Courses

description.describe_ch: 本課程希望透過韓文，增進同學對韓國的社會變遷與生活環境有深刻的瞭解，拓寬身為知識份子的宏觀視野，掌握韓國與台灣的互動關係。
description.describe_eh: Through this course, students will understand more about the living environment and changing society in Korea. Also, students will broaden their views and know the interactions between Taiwan and Korea.

targets.describe_ch: 本課程的教學目的，將著重於培養同學學習韓文的興趣，並提高同學對於語言的應變能力。
targets.describe_en: The aim of the course is to increase students' interests in learning Korean and their response to this target language.

textBooks.tpb_book: 自編書 : 韓語發音、韓文(一)

weeklyScds.tpd_reading:

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
1. 缺課一次出席成績打90分、二次打70分、三次打30分、四次打0分、五次以上（含五次）請不用來上課（當）。但如請公假、喪假、病假除外（均一律提出佐證資料）。
  2. 若上課態度不好（如睡覺、聊天、滑手機）每次扣學期總成績的10分。 
  3. 若簽到代簽、代課、代考、考試舞弊行為等，被發現時都沒任何理由，學期總成績打0分。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
課堂禮儀

1. 多元化和包容性
    所有課程活動都將在同學之間的友好參與和互動氛圍中進行，彼此間尊重和欣賞每位同學的個人經歷、背景和觀點，如國內外各學制、多元入學及學習文化、性別等。希望您始終在本課程中應用最高的學術標準，並以有尊嚴和尊重的態度對待同學。

2. 課堂行為
    課堂上的行為始終應要及時、要專業、要做好準備、要有禮貌。同學、教師或其他講師間，應保有彼此尊嚴和相互尊重，才能進行有效的學習。為了確保有利於學習環境，冀望每個人都能做到以下幾點，彼此遵守課堂行為規則，習慣禮貌的文化。
(1) 學生應準時出席上課。如果您的上課時間，無法按時到課，請不要選課。 除非您生病或有緊急情況，否則應在上課前，要準時到達教室，並坐在位子上。如果您有某種原因必須提早下課， 請提前告知我。
(2) 所有學生在課堂上都應尊重每個人，並且在任何時候都應以合理、負責和禮貌的態度行事。
(3) 上課時請勿講話、閱讀、睡覺或做其他非本課程相關作業，除分組進行討論外，否則應盡量減少邊際對話。如果您正坐在一個可能在上課時和您聊天的人旁邊，請移到另一個座位，以免您屈服於誘惑。
(4) 當同學簡報或提問時，您應該專心地聆聽。當您簡報時，您應該面對自己的小組或全班同學大聲說話，讓同學能聽清楚。
(5) 允許使用筆記型電腦或平板等載具，進行課堂記筆記，否則應將其收起。
(6) 要確保在上課時，關閉手機、PDA等移動設備，並收起及保持靜音。
(7) 不得戴耳機上課。
(8) 穿著整潔，不要暴露。

3. 冀望以最高標準、互相尊重的專業對話模式，以多樣化和包容性，講述課程規則內容。

4. 教師得以引導學生方式，學習過程中學生要做的事，應有的責任。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Classrooms Protocol

1. Diversity and Inclusion
All course activities will be carried out in an atmosphere of friendly participation and interaction among students, respecting and appreciating each student's personal experience, background and perspectives, such as various school systems at home and abroad, diverse enrollment and learning cultures, gender, etc. You are expected to apply the highest academic standards throughout this course and to treat fellow students with dignity and respect.

2. Expected classroom behavior
Behavior in the classroom should always be prompt, professional, prepared, and courteous. Effective learning can only be achieved by maintaining mutual dignity and mutual respect among classmates, teachers or other lecturers. In order to ensure a conducive learning environment, everyone is expected to do the following, abide by each other's classroom behavior rules, and get used to a culture of politeness.
(1) Students should attend class on time. If you cannot arrive at the class on time due to your class time, please do not register for the class. Unless you are sick or there is an emergency, you should be in your classroom on time and in your seat before class starts. If you have to leave class early for any reason, please let me know in advance.
(2) All students are expected to treat everyone with respect in the classroom and to behave reasonably, responsibly, and courteously at all times.
(3) Do not talk, read, sleep or do other non-course-related homework during class, except for group discussions, otherwise marginal conversations should be minimized. If you are sitting next to someone who might be chatting with you during class, move to another seat so you don't give in to temptation.
(4) You should listen attentively when classmates present or ask questions. When you present, you should speak loudly to your group or class so that they can hear you clearly.
(5) Laptops or tablets are allowed to take notes in class, otherwise they should be put away.
(6) Make sure that mobile devices such as mobile phones and PDAs are turned off during class, and put away and keep silent.
(7) Students are not allowed to wear earphones in class.
(8) Dress neatly without revealing.
It is hoped that the content of the course rules will be described in a professional dialogue mode of the highest standard and mutual respect, with diversity and inclusiveness.
Teachers are able to guide students in ways, what students should do in the learning process, and their due responsibilities.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem: 多樣化、公平和包容性聲明 我的教學設計，要讓來自不同背景和觀點的學生都能從這門課程中獲得很好的學習，學生的學習需求能得到解決，學生帶給這門課的多樣性可以經舉手、邀請您合適地表達出來，並被視為一種資源、力量並惠及所有學生。如有任何疑慮，請利用請益時間來找我。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
學習必須以誠信為基礎，任何學生企圖將自己未製作的作品，作為自己的作品，此行為是為不誠實行為。在作業、測驗或考試中作弊或抄襲的學生或協助他人的行為，該次成績以零分計，若是累犯，將依逢甲大學學生獎懲辦法提送。
  • 考核時如果您抄襲他人的答案、或交作業時您交出全部或部分由他人撰寫的論文或作業，則被視為作弊。
  • 考核時如果您抄襲他人的答案、或交作業時您交出全部或部分由他人撰寫的論文或作業，則被視為作弊。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
Learning must be based on honesty. Any student who attempts to use a work that he has not produced as his own is considered dishonest. Students who cheat or plagiarize in homework, tests or exams, or assist others, will be scored as zero. If they are repeat offenders, they will be submitted in accordance with the rewards and punishments for students of Feng Chia University.
  • It is considered cheating if you copy someone else's answers during an assessment, or if you turn in a paper or assignment that was written in whole or in part by someone else when you turned in an assignment.
  • It is considered cheating if you copy someone else's answers during an assessment, or if you turn in a paper or assignment that was written in whole or in part by someone else when you turned in an assignment.
